docs.text: Gotify 计算巢部署文档 服务说明 Gotify 是一款 MIT 许可开源自托管的推送消息服务器：提供 REST 接口发送通知、WebSocket 实时推送到多用户 Web 控制台，并支持按应用独立令牌、消息优先级与插件扩展。脚本、监控、CI、IoT 设备都可以用应用令牌向它发消息，Web 控制台和 Android 客户端负责接收，全部数据保存在自己的服务器上，适合替代第三方推送服务搭建内部告警与通知中心。 本计算巢服务采用单机 ECS 部署，ECS 镜像内已预置 Gotify 与 Docker Compose 运行环境，消息与账号数据保存在实例本机的 SQLite 数据库中。 访问入口为实例公网 IP 的 80 端口。打开地址即进入登录页，用户名固定为 admin ，初始密码在服务实例输出中查看。 计费说明 通过此服务模板构建服务不产生费用。用户部署服务实例时，资源费用主要涉及： ECS 实例规格（最低 2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存） 系统盘容量（模板固定 200 GiB ESSD） 公网带宽（模板固定 5 Mbps） 计费方式支持按量付费和包年包月，预估费用会在部署前实时展示。 RAM账号所需权限 若使用 RAM 用户创建服务实例，需要在创建服务实例前为该 RAM 用户添加相应权限。 权限策略名称 备注 AliyunECSFullAccess 管理云服务器 ECS 的权限 AliyunVPCFullAccess 管理专有网络 VPC 的权限 AliyunROSFullAccess 管理资源编排 ROS 的权限 AliyunComputeNestUserFullAccess 管理计算巢服务用户侧资源的权限 服务实例部署流程 部署步骤 打开计算巢服务实例创建页面，选择部署地域，填写实例规格、实例密码。网络可选择新建 VPC，也可以选择已有的 VPC 与交换机。 部署链接 确认询价明细后点击 下一步：确认订单 ，同意服务协议并点击 立即创建 。 等待服务实例部署完成。部署完成后，在服务实例详情页的 输出 区域查看 gotify_80_url 访问地址、 AdminUsername 用户名与 AdminPassword 管理员密码；输出中还有推送调用、安全默认值、数据持久化与单点登录等说明，建议一并阅读。 用浏览器打开输出中的访问地址（ http://<实例公网IP> ），使用用户名 admin 与输出中的管理员密码登录，进入控制台。 首次使用说明 1. 创建应用并发送第一条消息 登录后进入 APPS 页，点击 CREATE APPLICATION 新建一个应用（例如 nightly-backup ），即可获得该应用的推送令牌。随后在任意能访问实例的机器上执行： curl "http://<实例公网IP>/message?token=<应用令牌>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"title":"备份任务完成","message":"nightly-backup 于 02:00 完成，耗时 3 分 12 秒","priority":5}' 也可以把令牌放在 X-Gotify-Key 请求头里。消息发出后，控制台会通过 WebSocket 实时收到。 2. 客户端接入 Android 可安装 Gotify 官方客户端，填入实例访问地址与应用令牌即可在手机上收推送。控制台本身支持多用户，可在 USERS 页为团队成员创建各自账号，管理员账号另行保留。 3. 数据持久化 全部状态保存在系统盘的 /opt/gotify/data 目录（SQLite 库文件 gotify.db ，以及 images 与 plugins 两个子目录）。执行 docker compose down 或重建容器不会丢数据；释放实例即全部丢失，请定期备份该目录。SQLite 模式下上游把最大打开连接数限制为 1，消息量很大时建议关注磁盘余量与写入延迟。 4. 修改管理员密码 GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS 只在数据库首次创建时生效，之后改动该变量或重新部署都不会覆盖已有账号。如需改密，登录后在用户菜单中修改即可；若要重置为全新账号，需要在实例上执行 cd /opt/gotify && docker compose down 、清空 /opt/gotify/data 后重新 docker compose up -d （会丢失全部历史消息）。 5. 安全默认值 出厂已关闭公开注册、保持本地鉴权开启、关闭服务端 TLS 并保持会话 Cookie 不带 Secure 标记（纯 HTTP 交付所必需）；容器已做能力裁剪与 no-new-privileges 加固，未挂载宿主 Docker socket，非特权运行。如需开放注册，可编辑 /opt/gotify/.env 后执行 cd /opt/gotify && docker compose up -d ，但公网开放注册等于允许任意访客自建账号，不建议。 6. 启用 OIDC 单点登录 该版本内置 OIDC 支持（ GOTIFY_OIDC_ENABLED ，出厂为 false），可对接 Authelia、Dex、Keycloak 等身份提供方，要求对方支持 PKCE，回调地址需以 /auth/oidc/callback 结尾。启用后 IdP 的组声明会在每次登录时接管管理员权限并覆盖手工改动，请评估后再开启。 参数说明 参数 说明 默认值 VpcOption 网络类型，新建 VPC 或使用已有 VPC NewVPC VpcCidrBlock 新建 VPC 的网段 192.168.0.0/16 VSwitchCidrBlock 新建交换机的网段 192.168.1.0/24 EcsInstanceType ECS 实例规格，可选 2–4 vCPU 的 ecs.u1 / ecs.e 系列 无 InstancePassword 实例登录密码 无 PayType 付费类型 PostPaid ZoneId 可用区 无 VpcId / VSwitchId 已有 VPC 与交换机 ID（选择已有 VPC 时填写） 空 输出说明 输出 说明 gotify_80_url Gotify 访问地址（端口 80） AdminUsername 管理员用户名（admin） AdminPassword 系统随机生成的管理员密码 QuickStartGuide / PushMessageUsage 登录与推送调用说明 SecurityDefaultsNote / HttpDeliveryNote 出厂安全默认值与明文 HTTP 交付限制 DataPersistenceNote / PasswordChangeNote 数据持久化与密码修改方式 SsoCapabilityNote OIDC 单点登录能力说明 安全与使用说明 实例以公网 IP 加明文 HTTP 交付，未配置域名与 TLS。若自行在前面加 TLS 反向代理，必须同时把 GOTIFY_SERVER_SECURECOOKIE 改为 true 并把代理地址写入 GOTIFY_SERVER_TRUSTEDPROXIES ，否则取不到真实客户端 IP，并需保证 WebSocket 升级不被截断。 应用令牌等同于该应用的发送权限，不要写进前端代码或公开仓库。 公网暴露的推送服务建议按需限制来源 IP，并定期检查 USERS 与 APPS 列表。 所有数据保存在系统盘 /opt/gotify/data ，释放服务实例会一并删除，请提前备份。 常见问题 登录提示用户名或密码错误？ 用户名固定为 admin ，密码在服务实例输出的 AdminPassword 中。如果之前改过密码或复用了旧数据目录，请使用修改后的密码。 curl 推送返回 401 或 403？ 401 表示应用令牌错误或已删除，请到 APPS 页重新确认令牌；403 通常说明请求路径不对，推送应发往 /message?token=<令牌> 或使用 X-Gotify-Key 请求头。 控制台收不到实时消息？ WebSocket 需要直连实例，若中间加了反向代理，请确认代理放行了 WebSocket 升级。 官方链接 官方仓库：https://github.com/gotify/server 官方文档：https://gotify.net/docs 许可证：MIT

docs.text: Deploying Gotify on Alibaba Cloud Compute Nest About the service Gotify is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted push notification server. It exposes a REST endpoint for sending messages, pushes them over WebSocket to a multi-user web console, and supports per-application tokens, message priorities and plugins. Scripts, monitoring, CI and IoT devices send notifications with an application token; the web console and the Android client receive them, and all data stays on your own server. This Compute Nest service deploys a single ECS instance. The image already contains Gotify and its Docker Compose runtime, and both messages and accounts live in a local SQLite database on the instance. Gotify is served on port 80 of the instance public IP. Opening the address shows the sign-in page; the username is always admin and the initial password is listed in the service instance outputs. Billing Creating a service from this template is free. Running a service instance incurs: ECS instance (minimum 2 vCPU, 4 GiB memory) System disk (fixed at 200 GiB ESSD by the template) Public bandwidth (fixed at 5 Mbps by the template) Both pay-as-you-go and subscription are supported; the estimate is shown before you confirm the order. Required RAM permissions If you create the instance with a RAM user, grant the following policies first. Policy Purpose AliyunECSFullAccess Manage ECS instances AliyunVPCFullAccess Manage VPC resources AliyunROSFullAccess Manage Resource Orchestration Service stacks AliyunComputeNestUserFullAccess Manage Compute Nest user-side resources Deployment steps Open the instance creation page, choose a region, and specify the instance type and instance password. You can create a new VPC or use an existing VPC and vSwitch. Deploy now Review the price estimate, choose Next: Confirm Order , accept the service agreement and click Create Now . Wait for the deployment to finish. The Outputs section of the instance details page lists gotify_80_url , AdminUsername and AdminPassword , plus notes on message sending, security defaults, data persistence and single sign-on that are worth reading. Open the URL from the outputs ( http://<public-ip> ), sign in as admin with the generated password and reach the console. First steps Create an application and send your first message Open APPS and click CREATE APPLICATION (for example nightly-backup ) to get a push token for that application. Then run this from any machine that can reach the instance: curl "http://<public-ip>/message?token=<app-token>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"title":"Backup finished","message":"nightly-backup completed at 02:00 in 3m12s","priority":5}' The token can also be sent in the X-Gotify-Key header. The console receives the message over WebSocket in real time. Connect clients The official Gotify Android client can be pointed at the instance URL plus an application token. The console supports multiple users, so you can add team accounts under USERS and keep the admin account separate. Data persistence All state lives in /opt/gotify/data on the system disk (the SQLite file gotify.db plus the images and plugins directories). docker compose down and container rebuilds keep the data; releasing the instance deletes it, so back up that directory regularly. In SQLite mode the upstream project caps the open connection count at 1, so write operations are serialized; watch disk headroom and write latency when message volume is high. Change the admin password GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS only applies when the database is first created; editing it later or redeploying does not override an existing account. To change the password, sign in and use the user menu. To reset to a fresh account, run cd /opt/gotify && docker compose down on the instance, clear /opt/gotify/data , then docker compose up -d (all history is lost). Security defaults Public registration is disabled, local authentication stays on, server-side TLS is off and the session cookie is not marked Secure (required for plain HTTP delivery). The container runs unprivileged with capability dropping and no-new-privileges , and the host Docker socket is not mounted. To enable registration, edit /opt/gotify/.env and run cd /opt/gotify && docker compose up -d ; exposing registration publicly lets any visitor create an account and is not recommended. Enable OIDC single sign-on OIDC support is built in ( GOTIFY_OIDC_ENABLED , false by default) and works with providers such as Authelia, Dex and Keycloak. The provider must support PKCE and the callback address must end with /auth/oidc/callback . Once enabled, the IdP group claim takes over admin rights on every sign-in and overrides manual changes, so evaluate this before turning it on. Parameters Parameter Description Default VpcOption Create a new VPC or reuse an existing one NewVPC VpcCidrBlock CIDR block of the new VPC 192.168.0.0/16 VSwitchCidrBlock CIDR block of the new vSwitch 192.168.1.0/24 EcsInstanceType ECS instance type, 2–4 vCPU ecs.u1 / ecs.e families none InstancePassword Password for the ECS instance none PayType Billing method PostPaid ZoneId Availability zone none VpcId / VSwitchId Existing VPC and vSwitch (when reusing a VPC) empty Outputs Output Description gotify_80_url Gotify URL (port 80) AdminUsername Admin username ( admin ) AdminPassword Generated admin password QuickStartGuide / PushMessageUsage Sign-in and message sending notes SecurityDefaultsNote / HttpDeliveryNote Factory security defaults and plain HTTP limits DataPersistenceNote / PasswordChangeNote Data persistence and password change notes SsoCapabilityNote OIDC single sign-on notes Security notes The instance is delivered over plain HTTP on a public IP without a domain or TLS. If you put a TLS reverse proxy in front, also set GOTIFY_SERVER_SECURECOOKIE to true and list the proxy in GOTIFY_SERVER_TRUSTEDPROXIES , otherwise the real client IP is lost; make sure WebSocket upgrades are not truncated. An application token grants send rights for that application. Do not embed it in front-end code or public repositories. For an internet-facing push server, restrict source IPs where possible and review the USERS and APPS lists regularly. All data lives under /opt/gotify/data on the system disk and is deleted with the instance. Troubleshooting Sign-in says the username or password is wrong. The username is admin and the password is the AdminPassword output value (or the password you changed it to). A reused data directory keeps its old password. curl returns 401 or 403. 401 means the application token is wrong or deleted; check it on the APPS page. 403 usually means the path is wrong: send to /message?token=<token> or use the X-Gotify-Key header. No real-time messages in the console. WebSocket needs a direct connection to the instance; if a reverse proxy sits in between, make sure it allows the WebSocket upgrade. Links Source code: https://github.com/gotify/server Documentation: https://gotify.net/docs License: MIT

docs.text: Open the instance creation page, choose a region, and specify the instance type and instance password. You can create a new VPC or use an existing VPC and vSwitch. Deploy now Review the price estimate, choose Next: Confirm Order , accept the service agreement and click Create Now . Wait for the deployment to finish. The Outputs section of the instance details page lists gotify_80_url , AdminUsername and AdminPassword , plus notes on message sending, security defaults, data persistence and single sign-on that are worth reading. Open the URL from the outputs ( http://<public-ip> ), sign in as admin with the generated password and reach the console.
docs.title: Deployment steps

docs.text: Open APPS and click CREATE APPLICATION (for example nightly-backup ) to get a push token for that application. Then run this from any machine that can reach the instance: curl "http://<public-ip>/message?token=<app-token>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"title":"Backup finished","message":"nightly-backup completed at 02:00 in 3m12s","priority":5}' The token can also be sent in the X-Gotify-Key header. The console receives the message over WebSocket in real time.
docs.title: Create an application and send your first message

docs.text: The official Gotify Android client can be pointed at the instance URL plus an application token. The console supports multiple users, so you can add team accounts under USERS and keep the admin account separate.
docs.title: Connect clients

docs.text: All state lives in /opt/gotify/data on the system disk (the SQLite file gotify.db plus the images and plugins directories). docker compose down and container rebuilds keep the data; releasing the instance deletes it, so back up that directory regularly. In SQLite mode the upstream project caps the open connection count at 1, so write operations are serialized; watch disk headroom and write latency when message volume is high.
docs.title: Data persistence

docs.text: GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS only applies when the database is first created; editing it later or redeploying does not override an existing account. To change the password, sign in and use the user menu. To reset to a fresh account, run cd /opt/gotify && docker compose down on the instance, clear /opt/gotify/data , then docker compose up -d (all history is lost).
docs.title: Change the admin password

docs.text: Public registration is disabled, local authentication stays on, server-side TLS is off and the session cookie is not marked Secure (required for plain HTTP delivery). The container runs unprivileged with capability dropping and no-new-privileges , and the host Docker socket is not mounted. To enable registration, edit /opt/gotify/.env and run cd /opt/gotify && docker compose up -d ; exposing registration publicly lets any visitor create an account and is not recommended.
docs.title: Security defaults

docs.text: OIDC support is built in ( GOTIFY_OIDC_ENABLED , false by default) and works with providers such as Authelia, Dex and Keycloak. The provider must support PKCE and the callback address must end with /auth/oidc/callback . Once enabled, the IdP group claim takes over admin rights on every sign-in and overrides manual changes, so evaluate this before turning it on.
docs.title: Enable OIDC single sign-on

docs.title: Outputs

docs.text: The instance is delivered over plain HTTP on a public IP without a domain or TLS. If you put a TLS reverse proxy in front, also set GOTIFY_SERVER_SECURECOOKIE to true and list the proxy in GOTIFY_SERVER_TRUSTEDPROXIES , otherwise the real client IP is lost; make sure WebSocket upgrades are not truncated. An application token grants send rights for that application. Do not embed it in front-end code or public repositories. For an internet-facing push server, restrict source IPs where possible and review the USERS and APPS lists regularly. All data lives under /opt/gotify/data on the system disk and is deleted with the instance.
docs.title: Security notes

docs.text: Sign-in says the username or password is wrong. The username is admin and the password is the AdminPassword output value (or the password you changed it to). A reused data directory keeps its old password. curl returns 401 or 403. 401 means the application token is wrong or deleted; check it on the APPS page. 403 usually means the path is wrong: send to /message?token=<token> or use the X-Gotify-Key header. No real-time messages in the console. WebSocket needs a direct connection to the instance; if a reverse proxy sits in between, make sure it allows the WebSocket upgrade.
